svg.data-cohort-selection: 90-degree exploratory Q1 and baseline-subtracted Q2: p <0.05 and abs(MI) >0.1; Both is their intersection, including opposite-sign responses
svg.data-cohort-uncertainty: 95% percentile mouse-cluster bootstrap; resample contributing mice with replacement within each region and recompute summed responsive / summed joint-testable counts; fixed session/group inclusion and shared resamples for Q1, Q2 and Both
svg.data-population-mean-filter: 90-degree Q1 AND baseline-subtracted Q2: each p <0.05 and MI >0.1
svg.data-nonq2-mean-filter: visual cortex; finite baseline-subtracted Q2 p and MI, p >=0.05; no example-only MI or firing-rate threshold; inherited QC-passing SUA firingRateHz >1
svg.data-heatmap-normalization: context SDF minus unit's own clean-context baseline mean (Hz); no SD normalization
svg.desc: One 54 mm-wide modality column, headed by the Neuropixels icon reused from Figure 3 and its modality label, replacing the condition legend. A: responsive VISp5 unit 964 and Q2-nonsignificant VISp4 unit 993; context trial rasters with matching raw context/control mean-rate traces directly below on identical raw-Hz y-limits. Titles are Responsive and Unresponsive; the latter means Q2-nonsignificant, not visually inactive. There are 34 clean context and 68 control trials. Context is green; control is a grey line at 50 percent opacity. B: context baseline-subtracted Hz heatmap for all 203 eligible visual SUA, retaining the frozen context-only Rastermap row order. Below, context/control mean traces share one baseline-subtracted Hz axis with plus/minus across-neuron SEM. Solid curves equally weight 37 pooled visual units, selected by 90-degree Q1 AND baseline-subtracted Q2: each p <0.05 and MI >0.1. Heatmap rows have no responsiveness filter. Dotted curves equally weight 92 cortical Q2-nonsignificant units: visual cortex; finite baseline-subtracted Q2 p and MI, p >=0.05; no example-only MI or firing-rate threshold; inherited QC-passing SUA firingRateHz >1. The two populations differ in anatomical scope but share the same Hz scale. SEM is sample SD (ddof=1) of per-unit SDFs divided by sqrt(neuron count), not trial or across-mouse uncertainty; response-selected descriptive curves. All SDFs use 5 ms bins, a normalized causal 25 ms exponential kernel with 250 ms support, and hidden pre-event padding. Tan/grey indicate preceding presentation/deviant windows. Each condition's baseline mean pools full 20 ms bins from its clean trials' preceding grey intervals. No baseline-SD division or zero-SD masking is used. The heatmap, population means and SEM use baseline-subtracted Hz. No colorbar is shown; heatmap colors span -44 to 44 spikes/s, with blue negative and red positive. A/B: one session, ecephys_830794_2026-01-27_11-25-31, from mouse 830794; their means do not pool across sessions. C: 90-degree either-sign responsiveness in LGd, VISp, VISl, VISa, pooled frontal, pooled hippocampal (HIP), SSp and pooled STR areas, in that order, across 13 QC-pass standard sessions from 13 mice. Each region has Q1, Q2 and Both bars, with blue, orange and green encoding respectively. Passing means p <0.05 and absolute MI >0.1, including suppression. Both is the intersection, including opposite-sign responses. All three bars use the same joint-testable eligible neuron denominator; numerators are restricted to that shared set. Bars pool neuron counts; error bars show 95% percentile mouse-cluster bootstrap intervals (10000 resamples) on all three bars, on a 0-100 percent axis. Each resample draws contributing mice with replacement within the region and recomputes summed responsive / summed testable counts, rather than averaging mouse percentages or resampling individual neurons. The same mouse draws are used for all three screens. Each session/group must have at least 20 QC-passing SUA, counted before firing-rate or response-test filtering and excluding curated probes. STR pools LSr, LSc, STR, CP and SH. Frontal, hippocampal and striatal constituent areas are pooled before this cutoff; excluded sessions contribute to neither bars nor bootstrap intervals. The existing >1 Hz and finite-test response denominator is unchanged. This either-sign cohort differs from B's positive-only solid curves. Undefined tests are not unresponsive. ProbeC is excluded for saturation in mouse 820454. Sample sizes and coverage are published in the linked cohort tables. Intervals are pointwise, conditional on the fixed inclusion rules, and exploratory with 5-13 mice per group; they are not simultaneous intervals or tests between bars. The first example passes positive Q1 AND Q2; the comparison has Q2 p >=0.05, abs(Q2 MI) <0.25 and session FR >3 Hz, with no Q1 restriction; this unit has significant negative Q1 modulation. Nonsignificance is not proof of no effect or absent visual responsiveness.
